scope: Four original-pitch tempo derivatives and their existing browser rehearsal consumer; no new composition, native rewrite or hosted redeployment.

environment.processor: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
environment.actor: Codex implementing agent; scripted input and frame/signal review
environment.audio: Actual Web Audio decode/playback/OfflineAudioContext; no physical output listening

checks.scope: 10 original full-song workflow cases and six final rehearsal cases; four affected full-song playback/error/tab cases rerun after startup fix.
checks.registered_test_runner: Controlled failing assertion produced failure before counting actual registered cases.

verified.probe_method: Own stereo fixture: five isolated 440Hz tones and five deterministic noise pulses at two speeds, processed then Vorbis-encoded/decoded. Interpolated positive crossings estimate pitch; pulse peaks are measured against expected onset. Not a music/hardware test.
verified.envelope_method: Original/master versus final decoded derivative, mean stereo, 3–14kHz third-order bandpass, 220-frame RMS envelope. Eight four-bar starts per asset, source window −120…+300ms warped by tempo; normalized correlation searches ±100ms at 5ms resolution. Bounded sample, not every note or perceptual latency.
verified.spectral_method: One-second real Midnight Signal ending excerpt rendered by Chromium OfflineAudioContext. Original buffer at old 0.75/0.9 node rates versus actual derivative at unit rate; sample Hann FFT local maxima above 3% prominence, 200–1000Hz. Peak order/sidebands can change with stretch; this is not physical listening or identical timbre.
verified.media_failure: 404 and original/wrong-duration asset rejected before source/click creation; explicit retry plays valid derivative. No detuned fallback.

loading_interruption.before: Actual foreground-tab departure during a gated download failed to return loading to ready (3s controlled timeout).
loading_interruption.after: Same case resets to ready with zero backing/click starts, requires explicit Start, and a late Rain response cannot replace a new Midnight 90% run. Six final rehearsal cases and four affected full-run cases pass.

preservation.unrelated_registry_rows: All existing assets, other project rows and other transfers remain semantically identical; only AUD-005 is added.

verified.hosted_checks: Existing four jobs retained; rendered derivatives/encoded probes added and existing browser suite consumes them. Actual final status is confirmed at task closure.

reasoned_assessment: Codex reviewed actual paused/hold and narrow configuration frames: original-pitch/BPM labels and controls remain readable in these samples. Signals support removal of the prior pitch shift; broader timbre/attack naturalness or improved learning are not inferred. Offline preparation suits fixed speeds and avoids a new realtime DSP/engine dependency.
resolved_findings: Cross-filesystem staged replace failed before assets were published; copy to a same-directory temporary output before replacement.
Initial restricted Node output counted files; counts here come from actual registered assertions with a controlled failure check.
Loading-time tab loss exposed an existing startup gap; epoch cancellation and post-resume/decode guards isolate stale responses.
Environment restart preserved source/media identities and completed logs; pending failures were read before continuing.
unverified: Physical listening, complete transient/timbre quality and hardware audio latency
Independent phrase practice, learning, enjoyment and accessibility
